video_title: Is Darius Acuff The Next Derrick Rose? Melo On How He’d Fix The Bulls

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony explains why he avoided joining the Chicago Bulls
quotes.excerpt: A little birdie told me that shit was about to break up in Chicago. So, I didn't want to walk into that.
quotes.quote: And a little birdie told me that shit was about to break up in Chicago. So, I didn't want to walk into that. You didn't want to go to no bullshit. Yeah, it was just like, it was a lot of business that wasn't handled. Contracts, people leaving, and coaches were leaving, it was whispers. So I didn't want to deal with that. And I was already comfortable here, so the only place I'd have left for would have been Chicago.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: The Kid Mero criticizes the Bulls' drafting and trading strategy
quotes.excerpt: We been picking. We ain't picking the right picks. I'm telling you, we need to free agent.
quotes.quote: We in rebuild. But what I'm saying is, we been picking. We ain't picking the right picks. I'm telling you, we need to free agent. We need to just, we need to go get somebody who already, that we done all seen like they could play. Cause the people, now I know they, they just, we just switched over, we just got a new VP. I'm gonna get him a chance. Cause I'm always about giving chances. But I'm just saying, bro, all the players we drafted, we trade them. And then the thing about it is, when we trade them, all of a sudden the niggas come home.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on Bulls needing a franchise player since Derrick Rose
quotes.excerpt: The Bulls haven't had one guy that they can build around since Derrick Rose.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: But the Bulls haven't had, in all fairness, the Bulls haven't had one guy that they can build around since Derrick Rose.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: Since D-Rose. Okay. And Jimmy Butler was there, you get what I'm saying? But like, we could build around Jimmy.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: Yeah, but Jimmy at that point was already ready to go. And then Jimmy, and that shit he did, he got to do in Miami with the different hairstyles and shit. We only gonna do one of them. We had Dennis Rodman and Caleb Williams painting their nails, that's it. So we ain't had no room for that. I love Jimmy, but he did what he was supposed to do.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on Darius Acuff as a potential Derrick Rose
quotes.excerpt: Chicago needs the next iteration of a D-Rose. They need a dog.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: What do that mean? Okay, so who we picking?

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: It's a deep draft, I think.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: Who you pick? Yeah, who we picking? Who you think they taking?

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: Who you want to build? Who you could build around is the question.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: Who can we pick in four that we could build around?

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: All right, you got Darius Acuff. I think Acuff, Caleb Wilson.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: I like Acuff. North Carolina.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: No, Chicago.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: He gonna be gone by then?

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: Hear me out what I'm going to do. Chicago needs the next iteration of a D-Rose. They need a dog. The only person that could get that to Chicago is a Darius Acuff type of guard personality. Tough, dog, killer, like you need that mentality in Chicago.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: The Kid Mero criticizes Billy Donovan's coaching with the Bulls
quotes.excerpt: Billy ain't won for shit. They even made an extra way to get in the playoffs. We can't even win that.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: If they brought me in to coach, it ain't even about the system or nothing like that. It's really about getting in these play, like really, really coaching them, pushing them to be the best possible player they could be. I feel like that last coach we had,

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: He's a Hall of Fame coach.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: Billy Donovan?

text_blocks.speaker: Rudy Gay
text_blocks.text: Yeah, for college.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: You just said that. No disrespect to Billy.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: You just saying, I'm playing devil's advocate.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: Yeah, that's cool, you can play devil's advocate, but I'm just saying. You had Billy Donovan.

text_blocks.speaker: Rudy Gay
text_blocks.text: Yeah, he was a devil though when he was in Chicago.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: Billy ain't won for shit. They even, they even made an extra way to get in the playoffs. They got the play-ins now. We can't even win that.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: The Kid Mero discusses Bulls' potential with Lonzo Ball healthy
quotes.excerpt: We were looking good when we had Lonzo and we had Coby and then we had DeRozan. Zach LaVine.
quotes.quote: You know what? We were, all right. We were looking good when we had Lonzo and we had Coby and then we had DeRozan. What's the other, my other light skin? Zach LaVine. We had him. We were looking good. Lonzo went down. And that kind of, I feel like that kind of exposed LaVine a little bit.
